items.title: The Abbey Art Centre as Postwar Refuge: 1946–56
items.venue: Ben Uri Gallery and Museum, London

items.text: Between 1921 and 1931, Enwonwu attended five primary schools: St
Patrick's School, Ibusa, and later enrolled at the Government College, Ibadan, completing his secondary education at Government College Umuahia in 1937
At both colleges, he studied fine art under Kenneth C
Shell Petroleum scholarship: to study in the United Kingdom
National Merit Award: for academic and intellectual attainment in Nigeria
Commonwealth Certificate in London: for contributions to art by the Royal Institute of Art
Member of the Most Excellent Order of the British Empire (MBE)
Officer of the National Order of the Republic in Senegal
National Order of Merit in Nigeria: for contributions to art in Nigeria
